source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.section: I.G.1.e (Studio Showcases & Team Matches) and the Team Match definition that follows
source.quote_free_summary: A Team Match arranges entrants into teams of one school's students and teachers who dance simultaneously and are scored relative to each other; at most five teams per event; it uses a cumulative point system and places the whole team; at most three adjudicators; not part of a series.

requirement: A future NDCA profile must model one-school teams, the five-team cap, three adjudicators, cumulative-point team placement and exclusion from series. Studio/Custom 'Team match' implements none of this.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Future: NDCA profile. The generic Studio/Custom team model (2 to 100 members, no body rules) must not carry it (OD-28 item 9); it belongs to a future body profile.
interpretation_notes: NDCA: no explicit effective date is printed in the supplied PDF (cover: June 2026 edition); effective_from 2026-06-01 is the first day of the edition month and must be confirmed.
